finding: UI was already installed: relocated controls, new F1/backing and hidden return button exist. However hint is visible with original long text while backing is hidden; header/equipment also contain original long developer text. Failure screenshot independently shows original text. This is genuine overwritten presentation state, not a missing-install wait or a false assertion.
source_explanation: The ordinary Host queues _ordinary_refresh_after_modal with call_deferred and then calls _refresh_session_controls(true). A priority100 immediate Entry projection cannot order itself after that deferred refresh. This callback-order explanation follows source plus observed state; a callback timestamp trace was not recorded.
minimum_fix: Only Entry display projection is queued with Callable.call_deferred at the same guarded point, behind already queued Host refresh callbacks. Presenter rechecks current owner/screen/startup at execution. Host/Sim/Session/_launch_fresh/controller/presenter remain exact.
limitations: Deferred FIFO ordering covers already queued refreshes, not arbitrary future callbacks. Same postdraw equality and modal visibility gates remain hard requirements. New native run must establish the result.
probe_change: Preserve prior backing==hint check; add modal-both-hidden and actual text==last_projected for header/hint/equipment/footer/buffs. No extra wait is inserted before initial UI observation. Shader/deadline/owner gates unchanged.
